title: MAPPY FIA – 25/06/2026
summary: TodayTourist is pleased to accompany the teachers and students of the Rose Song School – aggregation of classes 4, 5, 7, 8 and 9 on the summer program experienced at Happy Farm.

content.text: TodayTourist is pleased to accompany the teachers and students of the Rose Song School – aggregation of classes 4, 5, 7, 8 and 9 on the summer program experienced at Happy Farm.

With 41 members involved, the trip gave the children the opportunity to blend in to nature, to explore the farm model, to engage in numerous beneficial experience activities and to train skills through practical learning. It is also an occasion for them to associate, bind, and keep good memories during the summer.
Thank the Board of Directors, the teachers and parents who have trusted the TodayTourist selection to accompany the show.
